# AUTO-CONTINUE SYSTEM

## Overview

Hard-coded error correction that automatically detects incomplete agent responses and generates "continue" prompts to push execution forward.

## Why This Exists

Claude AI (and other LLMs) sometimes:
- Provide suggestions instead of executing ("You could...")
- End with vague pleasantries ("Let me know if you need...")
- Ask questions instead of taking action
- Hit output limits mid-task

Instead of requiring manual "continue" prompts from Bob, this system *
